title: RFUAV v2.0 compliance profile for SigMF v1.2.6 .sigmf-meta documents
description: Second CI validation layer. sigmf-python 1.11.1 validates only the SigMF core STRUCTURE: it accepts misspelled core:* keys silently (additionalProperties:true), it does not anchor the core:datatype pattern (cf32_lefoo passes), and it knows nothing about the rfuav namespace (verificacion-empirica-02). This schema encodes the RFUAV compliance profile of g2-canonical-spec-v0.1 SS2/SS3/SS8 and is enforced by tools/rfuav_v2/validate_sidecar.py, which additionally performs the cross-field and filesystem checks that JSON Schema cannot express (see RULES table in that file).

sha512_lower.description: SHA-512 of the .sigmf-data file, 128 LOWERCASE hex chars. Stock SigMF allows [0-9a-fA-F] and is unanchored; the RFUAV profile pins case and length so that hashes are byte-comparable across manifests (D4).

iso8601_utc_z.description: Strict ISO-8601 / RFC-3339 UTC instant with a literal trailing Z. Naive local timestamps and numeric offsets (+08:00) are REJECTED. Calendar validity (no 2024-02-31) is checked in code.

session_id.description: {taxonomy_short}-u{unit:02d}-r{rx:02d}-s{site:02d}-d{YYYYMMDD}-{seq:02d} (spec SS2). This is the Shulman leakage grouping key: every simultaneous sub-capture of one over-the-air event shares it.

recording_id.description: {session_id}-c{cfg:02d} (spec SS2). The prefix relation to rfuav:session_id is checked in code (JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values).

taxonomy_id.description: {role}.{vendor}.{model}[.{variant}] (spec SS2). The bg role is 2-4 segments because spec SS1 mandates the 2-segment literal bg.kong for the background class, which the original 3-segment-only pattern REJECTED. Vocabulary fixes already approved: AVTA2->avata2, DIMINI4PRO->mini4pro, DAUTEL->autel, SKYDROID vendor merge. PARROT is uav.parrot.anafi (F4 / verificacion-empirica-05).

signal_state.description: SPEC-GAP-01: spec SS3 fixes exactly these four values, but the most frequent state token in the real library is 'daifei/dafei' (idle-but-powered) at 149/796 .iq files vs hover 17. Under this enum those 149 files must be labelled 'unknown', destroying a real class distinction. Proposal for rfuav.sigmf-ext.md v0.1.0: add 'idle' and 'background'. NOT applied here because SS3 was approved verbatim.

quarantine_status.description: Mirrors _quarantine/{partials|duplicates|ceshi|defective|misfiled|probe} (spec SS1) plus 'superseded' for sliced copies of a retained original (SS5) and 'none' for clean canonical records. Nothing is ever deleted; this field is the sidecar face of LEDGER.csv.

source_dataset.description: Closed vocabulary from spec SS1/SS7 (bundled/ + recipes/ source list).

protocol_mode_at_capture.description: F2: protocol modes are not traceable; every multi-protocol radio was captured in factory default state, so the library-wide value is factory_default_unverified.

spdx_id.description: SPDX short identifier of the ORIGINAL upstream licence (not the RFUAV v2.0 licence). Membership in the known-SPDX allowlist is a code-level WARN, not an error.

band_token.description: Controlled band token (e.g. 2g4, 5g8, 900m, 940m). The registry lives in manifests/taxonomy/labels.json; only the lexical shape is enforced here.

link_protocol.description: vendor.mode registry token: dji.ocusync2 / dji.o3plus / dji.o4, frsky.access, futaba.fasstest, flysky.afhds2a, elrs.24, wifi.80211a_n (PARROT ANAFI, F4 - the paper's 'FHSS 18.36 MHz' for PARROT is REFUTED).

foreign_namespace_key.description: Any key of a declared non-core, non-rfuav SigMF extension namespace (traceability:, signal:, ntia-core:, capture_details:, ...). Declaration in core:extensions is enforced in code.

core:datatype.description: EXACT equality. The stock schema pattern ^(c|r)(f32|...)(_le|_be)? is unanchored, so cf32_lefoo and bare cf32 both pass upstream (verificacion-empirica-02 Test 2). RFUAV is byte-identical complex float32 interleaved LE, so the only legal value is cf32_le (D1).

core:extensions.description: MUST contain {name:rfuav, version:0.1.0, optional:true}. Today sigmf-python only warns about undeclared extensions, but upstream announces a future hard ValidationError, so the declaration is mandatory from day one (verificacion-empirica-02 implication 1).

core:num_channels.description: RFUAV recordings are single-channel. Multi-channel grouping uses .sigmf-collection (1 archive = 1 recording, verificacion-empirica-02 Test 4). The SS8 size identity size = sr*2*4*duration assumes num_channels == 1.

rfuav:site_id.description: F5: the library has a single capture site, so s01 is a fact, not a placeholder. The axis stays first-class anyway (D6).

rfuav:attenuation_label.description: NOMINAL ladder step as written in the source filename (e.g. 35db). V04: the ladder is monotonic but NOT dB-true (slopes 0.58-0.77) and the -- in --Xdb is a separator, so X is an intended-signal-strength step, never a negative SNR. Ordinal WITHIN one arm only.

rfuav:attenuation_db.description: MEASURED attenuation, null until G3a calibration backfills it.

rfuav:snr_nominal_db.description: Nominal label only. E-006: AVATA2 nominal SNR2dB measures 29.9 dB, so ReferenceSNRLevel is untrustworthy library-wide. Calibrated values live in annotations as rfuav:snr_est_v2_db and NEVER overwrite this field.

rfuav:rx_gain_db.description: SS9-a recommended branch: mirror gain/attenuation/SNRdB into the rfuav namespace as OPTIONAL fields instead of declaring capture_details (whose 6 fields become mandatory and are unfillable for foreign sources).

rfuav:source_sha256.description: D4: upstream SHA-256 kept as an independent field; RFUAV's own integrity hash is always SHA-512.

rfuav:source_file.description: Original path lineage. traceability:origin is the preferred home; this is the flat mirror used by the migration manifest.

rfuav:redistributable.description: D7: bundled/ (physically redistributable) vs recipes/ (rebuild locally). Physical files never mix licences.

rfuav:attribution.description: Required by CC BY SS3(a) for every bundled foreign source.

rfuav:naming_dialect.description: Identifier of the source filename dialect this record was normalised from (SS5: 4 dialects + typos). Deliberately NOT a closed enum here - the dialect registry is owned by the dialect parser and its unit tests.

rfuav:gap_boundaries.description: Sample indices at which the recording is discontinuous (-lostN files, missing slices). MUST be strictly increasing and MUST be non-empty when rfuav:continuous is false; both checked in code.

rfuav:duration_s.description: ADDITIVE beyond SS3 enumeration: required to evaluate the SS8 size identity locally without opening the manifest.

rfuav:recording_index.description: E-002: v1's SerialNumber was a sequential file counter, not a hardware serial. Renamed here; the real receiver serial belongs in ntia-core HardwareSpec.id.

rfuav:capture_date.description: True capture date. NEVER the slicing date: the 11-26 mtimes are slicing dates (audit A).

annotations.description: Burst-level ground truth only (10^2-10^4 per file). Dense per-frame labels live in frames.parquet, never here (SS3).

then.description: D: SNR estimates are VERSIONED fields; an estimate without its method_version is unreproducible (RadioML lesson, C3 #103).
